_comment: For teammates using Claude Code or Cursor instead of Codex. Codex users don't need this — setup.sh wires MCP via 'codex mcp add'. Claude Code: copy this to '.mcp.json' at the repo root and 'AGENTS.md' to 'CLAUDE.md'. Cursor: copy to '.cursor/mcp.json'. Supabase + Vercel authenticate via in-browser OAuth on first use — no tokens to commit.

playwright._note: optional — drives a real browser; first use downloads ~100MB chromium
